name: GS-W Network Architecture
aliases: Gaussian in the Wild model parameters
definition: Defines the neural network components (Unet, Fusion MLP, Color MLP) and training hyperparameters for the GS-W method.
summary: The GS-W Network Architecture predicts per-Gaussian appearance and visibility from reference images using a U-Net encoder-decoder and fusion network, differing from standard 3D Gaussian Splatting by replacing static colors with neural features.
